command:
set -u
cd /srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
umask 022
TAB=$(printf '\t')
while IFS="$TAB" read -r name enc; do
  [ "$name" = "file" ] && continue
  [ -n "$name" ] || continue
  case "$name" in
    */*|.*) printf 'REJECT unsafe filename: %s\n' "$name" >&2; continue ;;
  esac
  src="incoming/$name"
  dst="normalized/$name"
  converted=$(mktemp "normalized/.${name}.converted.XXXXXX") || exit 1
  cleaned=$(mktemp "normalized/.${name}.cleaned.XXXXXX") || { rm -f "$converted"; exit 1; }
  err=$(mktemp "/tmp/${name}.iconv.XXXXXX") || { rm -f "$converted" "$cleaned"; exit 1; }
  if iconv -f "$enc" -t UTF-8 "$src" >"$converted" 2>"$err"; then
    perl -0777 -pe 's/\r\n?/\n/g' "$converted" >"$cleaned"
    if iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "$cleaned" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      mv -f "$cleaned" "$dst"
      printf 'PUBLISHED %s (%s -> UTF-8/LF)\n' "$name" "$enc"
    else
      printf 'ERROR %s: normalized data failed UTF-8 validation; no output published\n' "$name" >&2
      rm -f "$cleaned"
    fi
  else
    printf 'UNDECODABLE %s as %s; no output published: ' "$name" "$enc" >&2
    tr '\n' ' ' <"$err" >&2
    printf '\n' >&2
    rm -f "$cleaned"
  fi
  rm -f "$converted" "$err"
done < encodings.tsv
find normalized -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '.*.converted.*' -o -name '.*.cleaned.*' | sed 's/^/LEFTOVER /'
exit 0

command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
printf 'BOOT_ID=%s\n' "$boot"
printf 'OS='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s KERNEL=%s\n' "$PRETTY_NAME" "$(uname -r)"
printf 'SYSTEM_STATE='; systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- source integrity ---'
sha256sum incoming/invalid.txt incoming/utf8.txt incoming/western.txt
printf '%s\n' '--- output inventory ---'
find normalized -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\t%s bytes\t%u:%g\t%m\n' | LC_ALL=C sort
[ "$(find normalized -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" -eq 2 ]
[ -f normalized/western.txt ]
[ -f normalized/utf8.txt ]
[ ! -e normalized/invalid.txt ]
printf '%s\n' '--- UTF-8 and transformation checks ---'
for f in western.txt utf8.txt; do
  iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "normalized/$f" >/dev/null
  src_enc=$(awk -v n="$f" '$1==n {print $2}' encodings.tsv)
  expected=$(mktemp "/tmp/${f}.expected.XXXXXX")
  iconv -f "$src_enc" -t UTF-8 "incoming/$f" | perl -0777 -pe 's/\r\n?/\n/g' >"$expected"
  cmp -s "$expected" "normalized/$f"
  rm -f "$expected"
  printf '%s UTF8=valid EXACT_TRANSFORM=pass CR_BYTES=' "$f"
  od -An -tx1 -v "normalized/$f" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -c '^0d$' || true
  printf '%s LAST_BYTE=' "$f"
  tail -c 1 "normalized/$f" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n'
  printf '\n'
done
printf '%s\n' '--- exact normalized bytes ---'
for f in normalized/*; do printf '[%s]\n' "$f"; od -An -tx1 -v "$f"; done
printf '%s\n' '--- record structure ---'
printf 'western records (including empty): '; awk 'END{print NR}' normalized/western.txt
printf 'western empty records: '; awk 'length($0)==0 {n++} END{print n+0}' normalized/western.txt
printf 'utf8 records: '; awk 'END{print NR}' normalized/utf8.txt
printf '%s\n' 'ALL_PRE_RESTART_CHECKS=PASS'
